snippet.title: Vroom Room - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
The ultimate cozy idle multiplayer toybox. Collect dozens of toys, watch them drive and stunt around in handcrafted 3D physics-based spaces, then jump in and take the wheel whenever you like. Embrace the joy of discovery as you chill with friends, hunt for secrets and unlock rare toys. 

🚗 Wishlist Vroom Room on Steam: https://midnighte.rs/vroomroom-steam

This trailer was a part of ✨Midnight Screening 2026✨a showcase of new games, demo drops and trailers! Check out the full lineup here: https://youtu.be/FFpPlTp4eyo

See the full Midnighters lineup on our website: http://www.midnighters.games
